messages.subject: Helios - FTO opinion (US10,114,202)
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Please find our freedom-to-operate opinion attached. In short: the Helios solid-state on-chip beam-steering avoids the 'mechanically rotating optical scanner' limitation that is essential to claim 1 of US10,114,202, so we consider infringement risk low. The opinion can be shared with Tessandri on a non-reliance basis.

Anjali
